spans.s: 1. ŚŪ, only pf. śūśu, śūśuv, and aor. subj. 🞄śūśávāma, be superior or victorious (RV.).
śū, onom. in śū-kārá and śū́-kṛta.
ṣu, in V., for su after u, ū.
2. SU (= √ 1. sū), in sauti, suhi, and pp. 🞄sutá, urged, instigated (ŚB.).
3. SU (= √ 2. sū), in pra-savati (rare), 🞄pra-sauti (rare), pp. suta, son, and súṣuti.
2. sū́, V. ad. = su sú, well etc..
